textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 physical-education · Warm-up and Cool-down · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A warm-up prepares your muscles and joints before play. A cool-down slowly relaxes the body afterwards.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A warm-up prepares your muscles and joints before play. A cool-down slowly relaxes the body afterwards.
beats.speakEn: A warm-up prepares your muscles and joints before play. A cool-down slowly relaxes the body afterwards.

beats.en: Backward kicks: kneel on hands and knees and kick one leg up behind you, then the other. It strengthens the back and hip muscles.
beats.speakEn: Backward kicks: kneel on hands and knees and kick one leg up behind you, then the other. It strengthens the back and hip muscles.

type: Key Concept: A warm-up prepares your muscles and joints before play.
Rule: Backward kicks: kneel on hands and knees and kick one leg up behind you, then the other.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 physical-education · Warm-up and Cool-down · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Side lifts: kneel on hands and knees and lift one leg sideways. It strengthens the hips.

beats.en: Side lifts: kneel on hands and knees and lift one leg sideways. It strengthens the hips.
beats.speakEn: Side lifts: kneel on hands and knees and lift one leg sideways. It strengthens the hips.

beats.en: Seated twists: sit, lift your feet a little and twist side to side as if passing a ball. It strengthens the core muscles.
beats.speakEn: Seated twists: sit, lift your feet a little and twist side to side as if passing a ball. It strengthens the core muscles.

type: Side lifts: kneel on hands and knees and lift one leg sideways. It strengthens the hips.
Seated twists: sit, lift your feet a little and twist side to side as if passing a ball.
